purpose: Save/load/replay/host transfer preserves difficulty, archetype, scheduling and active plans; no silent profile drift

acceptance.requiredOutcome: Save/load/replay/host transfer preserves difficulty, archetype, scheduling and active plans; no silent profile drift
setup: Each lobby difficulty has an active archetype, scheduler debt and in-progress plans
Separate native multiplayer sessions use two real peers for host transfer/reconnect with the same selected configuration; multiplayer save/load is not supported or required
actions: In single-player, save/reload and replay the same logical input continuation at equivalent safe boundaries
Independently, transfer actual multiplayer host authority and reconnect peers without loading a save
Resume before the next scheduled decision rather than resetting cadence
measurements: Profile/version, archetype, RNG, debt/cursors, active plan IDs and exact next eligible decisions
Peer canonical state including shared queue metadata
required: Save/replay/host transfer preserve the selected profile and active scheduling/plan state
forbidden: Fresh cadence timer or opening/archetype roll after host transfer

capabilityLimits: Single-player save/replay and real multiplayer reconnect/host promotion are independent legs; multiplayer has no save/load.
Host-transfer coverage uses the actual current checkpoint received through native reconnect. It does not certify zero-loss abrupt failover without an available AI checkpoint.
Original and restored brains, cadence, profile, plans, claims and RNG remain separate actual boundaries; subsequent epoch fencing is an intentional authority change.
